# rsguide

**Diagnose remote sensing data and suggest analyses.**

rsguide takes remote sensing data (satellite images, elevation models,
points, polygons or tables with coordinates), automatically identifies
what they are and suggests which analyses are possible. Each suggestion
comes with a plain-language rationale, the necessary caveats and an
example code snippet already filled in with your files and bands.

The package **does not run** the analyses: it diagnoses and recommends.
It is aimed at ecologists and students who are new to remote sensing.

## Installation

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("RikD96/rsguide", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Example

``` r

library(rsguide)

# A file, an R object or a whole folder
folder <- system.file("extdata", package = "rsguide")
d <- diagnose(folder)
d                     # diagnosis and list of suggested analyses
summary(d)            # rationale and caveats of each analysis
show_code(d, "ndvi")  # code ready to copy
as.data.frame(d)      # report as a table (to save as CSV)
```

What
[`diagnose()`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/diagnose.md)
identifies:

- type of data: raster, vector (points, lines, polygons) or table with
  coordinates (`lon`/`lat`, `x`/`y`,
  `decimalLongitude`/`decimalLatitude`…);
- layers, resolution, coordinate reference system, extent and missing
  values;
- bands and likely sensor (Sentinel-2, Landsat 4-9 or generic names such
  as `red`, `nir`, `swir1`);
- value scale (0-1 reflectance, integers x 10,000, Landsat Collection 2,
  the +1000 offset of Sentinel-2…);
- digital elevation models, class maps and time series;
- whether vectors fall on the raster, and whether the coordinate systems
  match.

Analyses that can be suggested: NDVI, EVI, SAVI, NDRE, NDMI, NDWI,
MNDWI, NBR, supervised and unsupervised classification, change
detection, trend analysis, slope, aspect, watersheds and drainage,
extraction of values at points, zonal statistics and landscape metrics.

## Editable rules

Recommendations come from a table (`inst/rules/rules.csv`) where each
row is an analysis, with the condition under which it is suggested.
Inspect it with
[`rsguide_rules()`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/rsguide_rules.md)
and add your own rules without touching the code:

``` r

my_rules <- rbind(rsguide_rules(), new_rule)
diagnose(folder, rules = my_rules)
```

## Documentation

- [`?rsguide`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/rsguide-package.md):
  package overview, accepted inputs and recognized sensors.
- [`vignette("case-study-jurua", package = "rsguide")`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/articles/case-study-jurua.md):
  diagnosis of Sentinel-2 images of the Jurua River, near Cruzeiro do
  Sul (Acre, Brazil), from a single file to a folder with a time series,
  a DEM and field plots.
- [`vignette("custom-rules", package = "rsguide")`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/articles/custom-rules.md):
  how to add new analyses, write conditions and code templates.
- [`?jurua_data`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/jurua_data.md):
  the example data and their sources.

# Package index

## Diagnosis and suggestions

Start here. Give the data and get the diagnosis with the possible
analyses.

- [`diagnose()`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/diagnose.md)
  : Diagnose remote sensing data
- [`suggest_analyses()`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/suggest_analyses.md)
  : Suggest analyses from a diagnosis

## Reading and exporting the results

- [`show_code()`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/show_code.md)
  : Show the example code of a suggested analysis
- [`summary(`*`<rsguide_diagnosis>`*`)`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/diagnosis-summary.md)
  [`as.data.frame(`*`<rsguide_diagnosis>`*`)`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/diagnosis-summary.md)
  : Summarize and export a diagnosis

## Recommendation rules

The table that decides what to suggest, and that you can extend.

- [`rsguide_rules()`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/rsguide_rules.md)
  : Recommendation rules

## Example data

- [`jurua_data`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/jurua_data.md)
  : Example data: Jurua River, Cruzeiro do Sul (Acre, Brazil)

## About the package

- [`rsguide`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/rsguide-package.md)
  [`rsguide-package`](https://rikd96.github.io/rsguide/reference/rsguide-package.md)
  : rsguide: diagnosis of remote sensing data and suggestion of analyses
